senses.gloss:
वैमत्य वैमत्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-मति), differ-
ence of opinion, dissension; aversion, dislike; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a school of the White Yajur-veda.

वैमद वैमद, अस्, ई, अम्, of or belonging
to Vi-mada.

वैमनस्य वैमनस्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-मनस्),
distraction or agitation of mind, great sadness or sor-
row, distractedness, broken-heartedness; sickness.

वैमल्य वैमल्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-मल), spot-
lessness, cleanliness, purity.

वैमात्र वैमात्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-मातृ),
born of a different mother, the offspring of a step-
mother; (अस्), m. a step-mother's son, half brother;
(आ or ई), f. a step-mother's daughter.

वैमात्रेय, अस्, m. a step-mother's son; (ई), f. a
step-mother's daughter; a half sister, one by a dif-
ferent mother.

वैमानिक वैमानिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वि-मान),
[]
relating to a heavenly car, borne in divine chariots;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a particular class of deities.

वैमुख्य वैमुख्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-मुख),
turning away the face, avertedness, flight, retreat.

वैमूल्य वैमूल्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-मूल्य),
variety or difference of price, an unfair charge.
—वैमूल्य-तस्, ind. at different or various prices,
at unfair prices.

वैमेय वैमेय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. मे with वि),
barter, exchange.

वैम्बकि वैम्बकि, इस्, m. a patronymic from
Vimba.
